text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Russian newspapers this morning. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
KOMMERSANT DAILY
- Kidnappers in Chechnya are planning to free Russian journalists who have been kept captive since March.
- Anatoly Chubais, Finance Minister and one of the two first deputy prime ministers, is to name his deputies on Friday.
- Andrei Vavilov, former foreign trade minister, has been offered the chance to join the International Financial Company, one of the Russia's biggest commercial banks.
- Azerbaijan will transport its Caspian oil to Black Sea terminals via Georgia.
- The arms company "Rosvooryzgeniye" forecasts further growth of arms export.
SEVODNYA
- Anatoly Chubais called on the Federation Council to support the government's urgent and painful economic measures.

- A controlling stake in a unit of the Norilsk Nikel metals group is to be transferred to the government as a guarantee of payment of debts to the federal budget, according to the company's board of directors.
- There are more than two million private cars in Moscow.
NEZAVISIMAYA GAZETA
- Talks between President Boris Yeltsin and Chancellor Helmut Kohl were not very productive.
- The Federation Council had to agree it is impossible to fulfill the current state bugdet.
- Russian-Chinese cooperation is not aimed against any other country, says Russia's ambassador to China.
- The general level of taxes will be reduced, says Alexander Pochinok, the new head of the State Tax Service.
ROSSIISKIYE VESTI
- Russia's Interior Ministry is planning to examine the work of the State Customs Committee over the widespread practice of granting unjustifyed import and export privileges to various companies.
MOSKOVSKY KOMSOMOLETS
- Russia's Finance Ministry has started a campaign against a number of export companies which were granted export privileges in 1993 and remain the biggest state budget debtors.
- The daily publishes a list of recipes for the most popular dishes of the Russian Orthodox Easter, which is celebrated on April 27.
-- Tatyana Ustinova, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520.
